## LiteFace

**Face ID prompts use iOS 18's small animation at the top of the screen**, the one the Hidden apps folder uses, instead of the big box in the middle.

- Works wherever an app asks for Face ID: Passwords, banking apps, locked apps, App Store purchases.
- Only the look changes. What unlocks, and when, stays the same.
- No settings and no respring. To turn it off, uninstall it.

- **Installs on iOS 26 and 27** too. Before, Sileo only offered it on iOS 18.
- **RootHide** version added.
- Nothing else changed: same tweak, same behaviour.

- **iOS 18 to 27.** Rootless and RootHide jailbreaks.
- Face ID iPhones only. On Touch ID iPhones it does nothing.
- Tested on an iPhone 11 Pro (iOS 18.6.2).
- If it ever sends your phone to Safe Mode, open Sileo (it still works there) and uninstall it. Then [tell me](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues).
